395:t_3:67.en: ～$$ガルガンティア船団$$　Warehouse Block～

395:t_3:69.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「...You hadn't returned to $c, so I figured I'd find you here.」

395:t_3:71.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「I've arranged our transport. Some people in the fleet are frustrated with the situation, too.」

395:t_3:72.en:
$$レド$$
「Are there really $$ヒディアーズ#robot$$ there?」

395:t_3:73.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「I'd bet on it. I swear on my brother's life.」

395:t_3:75.en:
$$レド$$
「If $c won't act, I'll go alone.」

395:t_3:76.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「I'm counting on you. If you clear out the $$クジライカ$$, we'll handle salvaging the treasure afterward.」

395:t_3:78.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Relics of the great age... Basically, there's treasure from the distant past.」

395:t_3:79.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「We could sell it, or use its technology to fight $$サイデリアル$$. Either way, it'll help the fleet's future.」

395:t_3:81.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Then come to $$フランジ$$'s ship when you're ready.」

395:t_3:82.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「With all this trouble in the fleet, now's our chance to leave without anyone interfering.」

395:t_3:83.en:
$$レド$$
「...I have no choice but to do this.」

395:t_3:85.en:
$$レド$$
「$$エイミー$$... And $$ベベル$$, too...」

395:t_3:87.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Are you going to fight the $$クジライカ$$?」

395:t_3:90.en:
$$ベベル$$
「$$クジライカ$$ are truly terrifying if you attack them, but they never attack us first.」

395:t_3:91.en:
$$エイミー$$
「That's right! Don't you feel sorry for them!?」

395:t_3:92.en:
$$レド$$
「You should know how terrifying the $$ヒディアーズ#robot$$ are, $$エイミー$$.」

395:t_3:93.en:
$$エイミー$$
「B-but... The $$クジライカ$$ won't attack us.」

395:t_3:94.en:
$$レド$$
「The $$ヒディアーズ#robot$$ only ignore the fleet now because its civilization is so primitive.」

395:t_3:95.en:
$$レド$$
「They will bare their fangs someday. It could be this very instant.」

395:t_3:97.en:
$$レド$$
「I'll strike them before that happens.」

395:t_3:99.en:
$$レド$$
「This is my true duty. I live to kill them.」

395:t_3:100.en:
$$ベベル$$
「You're still you, even if you don't do that, $$レド$$...」

395:t_3:101.en:
$$エイミー$$
「That's right! $$宗介$$, $$アルト$$, everyone - they're human beings before they're fighters!」

395:t_3:103.en:
$$レド$$
「I... can't live the way they do...」

395:t_3:107.en:
$$レド$$
「My battle has nothing to do with either of you.」

395:t_3:109.en:
$$レド$$
「I don't intend to cause trouble for the fleet.」

395:t_3:110.en:
$$エイミー$$
「That's not it! I don't want you doing anything so dangerous!」

395:t_3:111.en:
$$エイミー$$
「You won't even have everyone from $c with you! I... I don't want that!」

395:t_3:112.en:
$$レド$$
「...Let go of me, $$エイミー$$.」

395:t_3:116.en:
$$ベベル$$
「Do you really have to go?」

395:t_3:118.en:
$$ベベル$$
「Is this really what you want to do, $$レド$$?」

395:t_3:119.en:
$$レド$$
「I'm doing this to protect humanity. To protect $$エイミー$$, too.」

395:t_3:120.en:
$$ベベル$$
「But my sister doesn't want that...!」

395:t_3:121.en:
$$レド$$
「...Do you still have the flute... I gave you when I left the fleet?」

395:t_3:123.en:
$$レド$$
「Originally, a child who looked like me was making that.」

395:t_3:124.en:
$$ベベル$$
「A child who looked like you...」

395:t_3:125.en:
$$レド$$
「Thinking back, he may have been my little brother.」

395:t_3:127.en:
$$レド$$
「Children who can't fight cannot survive in the Galactic Alliance. The $$ヒディアーズ#robot$$ are squeezing humanity's living space.」

395:t_3:129.en:
$$レド$$
「The $$ヒディアーズ#robot$$ on Earth will inevitably clash with humanity, too, if their territory expands.」

395:t_3:131.en:
$$レド$$
「They are $$ヒディアーズ#robot$$. If things become like the Galactic Alliance, you won't survive, $$ベベル$$. I don't want $$エイミー$$ to endure that loss.」

395:t_3:132.en:
$$ベベル$$
「No... You're wrong, $$レド$$! That won't happen!」

395:t_3:133.en:
$$レド$$
「I don't want $$エイミー$$ to suffer. So I'll... defeat the $$ヒディアーズ#robot$$!」

395:t_3:135.en:
$$ベベル$$
「...You'll come back to the fleet, won't you?」

395:t_3:137.en:
$$ベベル$$
「I'm only holding on to that flute for you. So... make sure you come back.」

396:t_000:0.en:
$$エイミー$$
「...The food at the party was delicious, wasn't it?」

396:t_000:2.en:
$$エイミー$$
「It was funny. $$ランド$$ drinking beer is nothing new, but $$セツコ$$ started drinking with him...」

396:t_000:3.en:
$$エイミー$$
「$$クロウ$$ ate and drank like there was no tomorrow because it was free. It looked like he regretted it afterward.」

396:t_000:5.en:
$$エイミー$$
「$$シェリル$$, $$ランカ$$, and $$エイーダ$$ sang, too, and everyone got so excited. $$ベベル$$ said he had fun, too.」
